svg.title: Telemetry. 985 contributions in the last year across 35 repositories; 40 active days; longest run 6 days; on GitHub since 2020. A year of daily contributions drawn as an oscilloscope trace, and languages drawn as propellant tanks filled by how many repositories use them.
svg.text: height is logarithmic, so quiet days still show
THERMAL MAP · EVERY DAY OF THE LAST YEAR
one cell per day, oldest on the left
PROPELLANT · LANGUAGES, BY REPOSITORIES THAT USE THEM
